description: In relay_client.rs, TLS_CLIENT_CONFIG is a LazyLock<Arc<rustls::ClientConfig>> initialized with expect(). If the rustls default crypto provider is not installed (e.g. in a test environment with a non-standard feature set), the LazyLock initializer panics on first access. This turns a configuration error into an unrecoverable process crash rather than a startup error. Fix: initialize the TLS client config in main() or in the relay queue constructor, returning a Result so the failure is handled gracefully at startup rather than as a panic during the first delivery attempt.
title: smtp: TLS_CLIENT_CONFIG LazyLock panics on rustls provider init failure
